method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME. The chosen corridor is lettered vertically 'AVENUE O.' inside its own roadway on BOTH sheets (sheet 46 between 22ND and 23RD ST; sheet 52 between 25TH and 26TH ST). WIDTH. Measured block-face lines: sheet 46 native 2070.2 and 2280.3 (210.1 px apart) -> centre 2175.3; sheet 52 native 2083.2 and 2293.7 (210.5 px) -> centre 2188.5. At this plate's scale 70 ft = ~212 px, so both are full 70 ft avenues, not the ~20 ft mid-block alleys. ADDRESS RUNS ACROSS THE LINE. Sheet 46, along 22ND and 23RD ST: west of the line '1619 1621 1623' / '1618 1620 1622 1624' (1600 block); east of it '1701 1703 1705 1707' / '1702 1704 1706 1708' (1700 block). Sheet 52, along 25TH ST (Rosenberg Av) and 26TH ST: west '...1619 1621 1623' (1600 block), east '1701 1703 1705 1707' / '1702 1704 1706 1708' (1700 block). The identical 1600/1700 change occurs across this corridor on both sheets. THE AVENUE'S OWN FRONTAGE NUMBERS. Sheet 46 reads 2200-2228 even on the north face and 2201-2227 odd on the south face (the 22ND-23RD block of Ave O); sheet 52 reads 2502-2534 even and 2501-2527 odd (the 25TH-26TH block of Ave O). Sheet 46 covers 21ST-24TH and sheet 52 covers 24TH-27TH, so 22xx and 25xx are two blocks of one continuous Avenue O address sequence running west - they cannot be two different avenues. ONE BLOCK NORTH is excluded: that corridor is Avenue N 1/2, north face 1173.4 on sheet 46, and it carries the 1500/1600 change ('1522 1524 1526 1528 | 1602 1604 1606' on 23RD ST), not 1600/1700. On sheet 52 no corridor exists there at all - the Ursuline Academy & Convent superblock (outlot 41) is built straight across Avenue N 1/2 - so N 1/2 cannot be the shared line. ONE BLOCK SOUTH is excluded: that corridor is lettered 'AVENUE O 1/2' on both sheets, north face 3064.7 on sheet 46 and 3079.6 on sheet 52, i.e. ~890 px east of the reported line; it bounds the FAR side of the 1700 block, so the 1600/1700 break cannot sit there. CANDIDATES REJECTED. None of the six proposed candidates is a street. Sheet 46's 778 falls between two interior lot lines at 729.7/840.2 inside block N.W./S.W. 43 with no name and no address change; 1778 and 2779 likewise sit in block interiors. Sheet 52's 784/1784/2785 are the same lattice offset. The values reported here are ruler-read avenue centres, not candidates. CROSS-CHECK. Three independently measured faces give the same sheet46->sheet52 x offset: Ave O north face +13.0, Ave O south face +13.4, Ave O 1/2 north face +14.9 (mean +13.8, spread 1.9 px) - against ~1002 px for a one-block error (Ave N 1/2 to Ave O on sheet 46 is 1173.4 -> 2175.3). The key maps agree: both sheets' key-map rectangles span the identical x range 3040-3410, so the two plates frame the same avenue band with no one-block shift.
